expires_today.title: Audio Alchemy Vol. 2: The Ultimate Game Dev Audio Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
We brought back one of our most popular series for a limited time—create the perfect audioscape for your next game or creative project with Audio Alchemy Vol. 2, the ultimate game dev bundle of subscription-free sounds from Ovani Sound. Highlights from this extensive library of commercial-ready assets include the Epic Music Pack Vol. 2, Horror Music Pack Vol. 3, Unreal Music Plugin, and more! Explore a variety of genres, from funk to electronic and everything in between. Get the assets you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support Children's Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before August 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Body Counts & Bloodshed: An Epic True Crime Bundle by Open Road Media
expires_tomorrow.description: Murders and mayhem and massacres, oh my!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

True crime heads, this one’s for you. Take a peek inside this giant ebook bundle full of killer true stories that test the boundaries of belief, courtesy of Open Road Media! Discover the truth behind the shocking “Goodbar” murder in Lacey Fosburgh’s Closing Time! Decide whether the dingoes really are to blame in the case of Lindy Chamberlain’s lost baby in John Bryson’s Evil Angels! Follow one heroic sheriff’s hunt for the kidnappers of an Olympic athlete in Johnny France and Malcolm McConnell’s Incident at Big Sky! These ripped-from-the-headlines nailbiters assemble all the gory details of real criminal cases both famous and obscure! These books must be experienced to be believed, so grab this bundle now at the price of your choice and support Active Minds with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Animal Style Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Take a bite out of boredom
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Calling all animal lovers—we’ve assembled the perfect mix of cozy and captivating games for you! Befriend and summon over 1,000 unique creatures in the epic dungeon-crawler Siralim Ultimate, manage a cute community of cozy dinosaurs in Amber Isle, beat up bad guys in the grim world of BROK the InvestiGator, where anthropomorphic animals have replaced mankind, and more. Pay what you want to punch your ticket into the animal kingdom of gaming and help support Trees, Water & People with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Idlers and Desktop Companions
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
There are few things more boring than sitting at a desk all day and watching the minutes tick by—that’s why we’ve made this bundle of games for anyone who needs a little office hours momentum! These idle games and desktop companions are built to fill time and provide some much needed motivation whenever you feel stuck in a rut. Gamify your tasks with Spirit City: Lofi Sessions, a focus tool that allows you to build your perfect cozy space! Turn your desktop screen into a lush homestead in farming simulator Rusty’s Retirement, an island paradise in Ropuka’s Idle Island, or a thrilling battlefield with Desktop Defender! There are even more ways to make your workday a little more exciting, so grab these games now at the price of your choice, and support suicide prevention charity CALM with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate Python Development Bundle by Packt
expires_tomorrow.description: Learn Python without the spendy pricetag
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Build websites and software, automate tasks, analyze data, and more using Python—the star of our latest Tech Book Bundle with Packt. Pay what you want for a curated 21-title selection that can help transform your development cycle and career prospects. Unlock fundamental eBooks like Python Illustrated, a visual deep dive into the basics of Python coding, Time Series Analysis with Python Cookbook - 2E, and everything else you need to dip your toes into one of the most versatile programming languages on the market, while helping support the Python Software Foundation with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Ultimate Stylized Bundle by SICS Games
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Toon-up your personal asset library with an injection of pure fun! We’ve teamed up with SICS Games on a unique cartoon-style bundle filled with vibrant color, fantastic designs, and easy-to-use UIs that fit seamlessly into whatever project you’re working on. Dive headfirst into new genres with hit asset packs like Toon Nature Assets, Toon Deserted Temples, Toon Adventure Island, and Toon Enchanted Meadow before it’s too late. Bring joy and exuberance to your next project with stylized toon assets today and help support No Kid Hungry.

expires_tomorrow.title: Even Steamier Sakura Special
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Add some spice to your summer with the 2026 Even Steamier Sakura Bundle of titillating titles! Are you ready for Mei-Mei? Your favorite bunny girls are back and more voluptuous than ever with Sakura Bunny Girls 1 & 2, the romantic visual novel games where you, an average Joe, encounter gorgeous supergirls! Or find love within the Sakura Isekai Adventure series, a set of yuri adventures that mixes real-life situations with cat-eared cuties! Turn up the heat and the fun with this epic collection by Winged Cloud, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 7th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: 2K Megahits 2026 Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
If your gaming library needs a summer refresh, look no further than this bundle of publisher 2K’s greatest hits!! Here you’ll find monster battling games, steampunk adventures, mobster action, and everything in between. Survive a hostile alien planet full of vicious beasts and plenty of loot in Risk of Rain 2! Work your way up the crime family ladder and become mobster royalty without getting whacked in Mafia II: Definitive Edition! Save a woman from a flying city and discover the secrets of BioShock Infinite! There are even more hidden gems and fan favorites to explore in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing and support Covenant House with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before February 7th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Cosmos Eclipse Game Dev Assets & Tools bundle (Unreal + Unity + Godot)
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Unleash your creative potential and bring your imagination to life like never before with a curated selection of premium 3D assets for Unity and Unreal Engine! Design your own take on the Big Apple with the 1950s NYC Megapack, quarter your forces within realistic fortifications with the Military Base Megapack, or add lived-in grit and character to your old-time titles with the Medieval Village Megapack. The savings don’t stop there—grab this massive 70+ pack bundle and unlock a 1-month subscription to Leartes’ Cosmos collection! Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support our furry friends at Canine Companions!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 1st, 2027.
